faq.q: What is the origin of Fikret?
faq.a: Fikret is associated with Arabic. Fikret is the Turkish form of Arabic فِكْرَة (Fikra), meaning 'thought, idea'.
Yes — the underlying form فِكْرَت is Arabic.
